summary: Annovis Bio filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for a marketed follow-on offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants, each sold in fixed combination with one five-year common warrant. Pricing is blank in this preliminary filing; the last reported NYSE close was $1.09 on November 3, 2026. Pre-funded warrants carry a $0.0001 exercise price and are offered to buyers whose post-deal ownership would exceed 4.99% (or 9.99% at election). No board recommendation, advisor, or overhang split is stated. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; the risk-arb angle is dilution and warrant overhang, not deal closure.
